features.text: Request capture in clock domain A
Request synchronization and acknowledge in clock domain B
Independent asynchronous resets for both domains

requirements.title: Domain A reset clears the captured request
requirements.text: While rst_a_n is low, dbg_req_a shall be 0.

requirements.title: Domain A captures a request on the next clock edge
requirements.text: When i_req is 1 and dbg_req_a is 0, dbg_req_a shall be 1 on the next rising edge of clk_a.
requirements.evidence: When `i_req` is 1 and `dbg_req_a` is 0, `dbg_req_a` shall be 1 on the next rising edge of `clk_a`.

requirements.title: Domain B reset clears the acknowledge
requirements.text: While rst_b_n is low, o_ack shall be 0.

requirements.title: Domain B acknowledges a synchronized request
requirements.text: When dbg_req_b_sync is 1 and o_ack is 0, o_ack shall be 1 on the next rising edge of clk_b.
requirements.evidence: When the synchronized request `dbg_req_b_sync` is 1 and `o_ack` is 0, `o_ack` shall be 1 on the next rising edge of `clk_b`.

requirements.title: A synchronized acknowledge is reachable
requirements.text: A cycle with dbg_req_b_sync 1 and o_ack 1 shall be reachable after reset in domain B.
requirements.evidence: A cycle with `dbg_req_b_sync` 1 and `o_ack` 1 shall be reachable after reset in domain B.
